summary: Implemented Lambda and Lambdad (aliases LambdaD and LambdaDict) with tests and docs; nothing committed. Changes: monai/transforms/utility/array.py gets Lambda(Transform) at the end, asserting callable(func) with "func must be callable". monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py gets Lambdad(MapTransform) between ConcatItemsd and the alias block, wrapping func in one internal Lambda and copying with dict(data), plus the LambdaD/LambdaDict alias line, the Lambda import, and the typing line changed to "from typing import Callable, Optional". The IdentityD line is untouched because it had no trailing whitespace. New tests: tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py (identity and slicing cases, unlisted-entry preservation, caller mapping unchanged). Docs: Lambda entry before SplitChannel and Lambdad entry after ConcatItemsd in docs/source/transforms.rst. Not run: tests, flake8, black (per instructions); verified by reading the git diff only. Choice: no separate iterable-callable test was added, since the listed test requirements cover only identity and slicing.
